title: ISRO IPRC Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 22 Fireman, Technician and Other Posts
description: The ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 22 Technical Assistants, Technicians, Firemen, and Other Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, ITI, or 10th Pass can use this opportunity and apply for the ISRO IPRC Notification 2026 . Here, we have included more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and...
